text: use filename patterns separate feeder data drinker data: Ollie’s Tip: 💡 Using different filenames? Just change pattern! example, files named FEED_20250715.csv, use pattern = "^FEED_.*\\.csv$". ⚠️ Important File Naming Rules: filenames must include date six digits (YYMMDD) somewhere name. code finds first six-digit sequence treats date! ✅ work great: - VR200306.DAT - Feeder_data_200306.DAT - wat_200306_01.DAT ❌ won’t work: - wat_01_200306.DAT (“01” appears date) easiest results, name files like mine: - Feeder data: VRYYMMDD.DAT - Water data: VWYYMMDD.DAT
code: # Find all feeder files (VR*.DAT) fileNames.f <- list.files(   path       = extdata_path,     # 🐄 Where to look   pattern    = "^VR.*\\.DAT$",   # 🐄 Pattern to match   recursive  = TRUE,             # Look in subfolders too   full.names = TRUE              # Include full path ) |> sort()                      # Keep them in order  # Find all drinker files (VW*.DAT) fileNames.w <- list.files(   path       = extdata_path,     # 🚰 Where to look   pattern    = "^VW.*\\.DAT$",   # 🚰 Pattern to match   recursive  = TRUE,   full.names = TRUE ) |> sort()
